part.text:
Fixed. Removed `sumifs` from the Excel 2019 function list in `src/PhpSpreadsheet/Writer/Xlsx/FunctionPrefix.php:134` — SUMIFS was introduced in Excel 2007, so it no longer gets a `_xlfn` prefix when writing XLSX.

The FunctionPrefixTest (15 tests) and ArrayFunctions2Test both pass; the single remaining error in the Xlsx writer suite is an unrelated environment issue (missing `imagejpeg` GD function in `DrawingsTest`).
